description: What it costs to RUN the system. Operational (management) transactions — settle, payment-hook withdraw, main→pool funding, defrag (consolidate), wallet shaping (split), and standalone deposit merge — are pure overhead no client reimburses; this dashboard meters their ADA cost by kind and by signer wallet. A deposit merge folded into an update tx is not counted here (it rides the update's fee). Update-tx fees are shown separately because they are the productive cost, offset by what clients are charged. Net cost ≈ operational overhead + max(0, update fees − client charges).

panels.description: Headline operational overhead: the last 24h fee rate of all management txs extrapolated to a full day, in ADA. This is the pure cost of keeping the system running (settle/withdraw/fund/consolidate/split/merge) — no client reimburses it. Update-tx fees are excluded here (they are the productive cost; see the bottom panel).
panels.title: Operational overhead — ADA/day

panels.description: Operational fee rate per management-tx kind, extrapolated to ADA/day from a 6h window. Shows WHICH activity drives the overhead — e.g. funding the pool vs reshaping wallets vs settling fees. Sums to the headline number above.
panels.title: Operational cost rate — ADA/day by kind

panels.description: Cumulative ADA spent in fees by each operational tx kind since the feeder (counter) started. The running total of pure overhead, broken down by what spent it.
panels.title: Cumulative operational fees — ADA by kind

panels.description: Cumulative ADA spent in operational fees by each SIGNER wallet. settle/withdraw/fund/merge are paid by the main wallet (it funds the pool, settles, and runs the standalone deposit merge); consolidate/split are paid by the pool wallet being reshaped. Shows where the overhead actually leaves the wallets.
panels.title: Cumulative operational fees — ADA by wallet

panels.description: Count of confirmed operational transactions by kind (cumulative). Pair this with the cost panels: a kind with many txs but low ADA is cheap-and-frequent (e.g. split), while few-but-pricey txs dominate the bill differently. Failed management txs are excluded here (they paid no on-chain fee).
panels.title: Confirmed management tx count — by kind

panels.description: Update-transaction fees (the PRODUCTIVE cost of writing prices on-chain), extrapolated to ADA/day from a 6h window. Shown for the full net-cost picture: unlike the overhead above, this is offset by what clients are charged through the PaymentHook. Net system cost ≈ operational overhead + max(0, this − client charges). This series is keyed by symbol/client, not by signer wallet, so the $wallet filter does not apply to it.
panels.title: Update-tx fees — ADA/day (covered by client charges)
